AirPods Pro 3 $50 off discount is still ongoing, Amazon has also brought back launch deals on the M6 Mac mini and Mac Studio, and the early fall Prime Day deals have been updated with new discounts. Today's 9to5Toys Lunch Break also includes the all-time low Amazon price on the Apple Watch Ultra 3 clearance at $200 off, plus exclusive discounts on iPhone 18 Pro cases, the all-new SANDMARC 3-in-1 Glare, Exposure, and Diffusion Filters for iPhone 18 Pro, and more. Don't miss the newly launched Beats 360 ANC over-ear headphones and the 20% off Cushion Kits modular accessories.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $199 (originally $249)

Amazon early fall Prime Day deals officially kick off: discounts on Apple, Pixel, Anker, Grubhub $20 off and more rolling out

Apple Watch Ultra 3 clearance deal arrives, all-time low on Amazon down to nearly $200 off

We're still tracking early bird deals for the Apple Watch Ultra 4 launch week (you can find them below), but Amazon is now offering an all-new all-time low clearance price on the Apple Watch Ultra 3 — the Natural and Black Milanese Loop versions are now nearly $200 off the original price.

Amazon is now slashing the Black Titanium and Natural Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 with matching Titanium Milanese Loop down to $699.97 shipped.

These configurations are the same as the Ultra 4 models, which are priced at $899, and both have hit all-time lows on Amazon:

  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Milanese Loop $700 (originally $899)
  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Milanese Loop $700 (originally $899)

Before Amazon's clearance deals today, we had never seen either model go below $749, and prices under $800 have been extremely rare — previously only dipping to this level once.

The Apple Watch Ultra 4 does have quite a few notable upgrades and improvements, but in my opinion, the third generation remains a more than capable wearable for anyone other than the most hardcore Ultra users and fitness enthusiasts. Our Apple Watch Ultra 4 vs Ultra 3 comparison article has all the details.

New M6 Mac mini and Mac Studio launch deals officially kick off, with discounts of up to nearly $50

Apple has officially launched its new generation of headless desktop machines, including the 2026 M6 Mac mini and M5 Max Mac Studio. Amazon has also brought back launch deals, with nearly $50 off on roughly each model, the best prices available.

These deals are certainly not super massive price drops, but keep in mind that these machines only just launched this week, so for users who want to buy early and enjoy them, they're the cheapest in town:

  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/256GB $880 (originally $899)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/512GB $1,070 (originally $1,099)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 24GB/512GB $1,270 (originally $1,299)

Although the launch deal on the 24GB M5 Pro Mac mini has not returned, we're also seeing the new 2026 Mac Studio with the M5 Max chip discounted by nearly $50 today:

  • 2026 Mac Studio M5 Max 36GB/512GB $2,450 (originally $2,499)

All of the above deals match the best cash discounts we've tracked to date.

All-new Beats 360 ANC over-ear headphones launch deal: limited-edition Cushion Kits modular accessories 20% off for just $10

As we mentioned yesterday in a larger Beats promotion, Apple-owned brand has officially launched the all-new Beats 360 over-ear headphones featuring modular ear cushions and headband pads. The product is now on sale, and we're also seeing launch deals in the form of limited-time discounts on the Beats 360 Cushion Kits — slashed to $9.99.

Beats 360 launch deals

The all-new Beats 360 over-ear headphones feature a modular design, allowing users to swap or replace the ear cushions and headband pads. The headphones themselves of course come with a matching pair of Cushion Kits, but now there are seven different colors of Beats 360 Cushion Kits available at a discount, so you can freely mix and match styles, or swap in a fresh pair of Cushions after a workout.

  • Beats 360 Over-Ear Headphones $350
  • Beats 360 Cushion Kit $10 (originally $50)

The Beats 360 Cushion Kit includes a pair of ear cushions and one headband pad. There are six different Performance Knit styles available, plus one UltraPlush style for a more traditional Beats feel (somewhat reminiscent of vintage leather).

The all-new Beats 360 becomes the flagship over-ear headphone in the lineup, offering "1.75 times more" noise cancellation than the Beats Studio Pro, personalized Spatial Audio with dynamic head tracking, beamforming call microphones that filter out background noise, and an IPX4 water resistance rating — the Beats 360 is the brand's first over-ear headphone with sweat and water resistance. It also supports Hey Siri and Find My.

Early fall Prime Day Ring deals from $40: new all-time low on latest 4K model with $100 off, more deals rolling in

  • All-new Beats 360 ANC over-ear headphones officially launch, Studio gets $130 off, more deals rolling in

Mid-range 13-inch M5 MacBook Air models now available for $150 off on Amazon

In addition to the ongoing AirPods Pro 3 deals, Amazon is giving you a chance to grab the mid-range 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with a $150 discount.

Amazon is now slashing the 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB RAM and an upgraded 1TB of storage down to $1,449 shipped.

Originally priced at $1,599, this model is now $150 off, making it one of the best deals we've tracked since the price hike wave began a few months ago. Although not all colors are slashed to this price, you can get the classic Silver, Sky Blue, and Starlight models at this price.

Speaking of the M5 MacBook Air lineup, any deal around $150 off is currently a solid choice right now. While $100 off isn't bad either, what we're really after is closer to $150 off, especially on any of the upgraded models.

The base model doesn't have any notable deals right now, but Amazon also has the 13-inch version with 24GB RAM and 1TB storage for $1,649 shipped — also $150 off the original price.

15-inch M5 MacBook Air models now available for up to $300 off at the Apple Certified Refurbished Store

While we're tracking today's $150 off deal on the new 13-inch M5 MacBook Air at Amazon, the 15-inch model at the Apple Certified Refurbished Store also has some solid deals if you act fast — we're seeing up to $300 off right now. Details below.

Act fast! The cheapest 2026 Studio Display at the Apple Certified Refurbished Store is $240 off

Over the past few weeks we've seen Amazon offer some solid deals on the latest 2026 Apple Studio Display, but the Apple Certified Refurbished Store is now offering a rare $240 off the original price, slashing the entry-level model.

The Apple Certified Refurbished Store is now slashing the 2026 Apple Studio Display with a tilt-adjustable stand down to $1,359 shipped.
